card.line: Pamphylia was a coastal region in southern Asia Minor where Paul's first journey passed through, and where John Mark left the mission, which later caused a split.

moments.title: Visitors at Pentecost
moments.text: People from Pamphylia were among the visitors in Jerusalem who heard the believers declaring the wonders of God in their own languages.

moments.title: John leaves at Perga
moments.text: Paul and his companions sailed from Paphos to Perga in Pamphylia. There John left them and returned to Jerusalem.

moments.title: Preaching in Perga
moments.text: After passing through Pisidia, Paul and Barnabas came to Pamphylia and spoke the word in Perga. Then they went down to Attalia and sailed to Antioch.

moments.title: A sharp disagreement
moments.text: Paul did not want to take Mark on another trip because he had deserted them in Pamphylia. The disagreement was so sharp that Paul and Barnabas parted company.

moments.title: Sailing past on the way to Rome
moments.text: On the voyage toward Italy, Paul and his companions sailed across the open sea off the coast of Cilicia and Pamphylia. They came to Myra in Lycia.
